title: Lilith Was Never One Woman
subtitle: How a Mesopotamian family of spirits, one biblical word, late-antique demonology, a medieval sexual argument, and modern feminism became a single legendary figure.
description: Lilith's history is not one unchanged biography. It is a chain of Mesopotamian spirit traditions, a biblical word, Jewish demonology, household magic, medieval folklore, Kabbalistic expansion, and modern reclamation.
author: EmberFire Research
methodology: This publication expands the approved EFR-LILITH-001 canonical article through a September 19, 2026 source review. It separates linguistic ancestry from personal identity, textual attestation from supernatural verification, disputed artifact identifications from secure object data, and later reception from ancient origin. Chronology is treated as evidence: similar names or motifs are not assumed to represent one unchanged figure without a demonstrable transmission chain.
